<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title id="pageTitle">Aluminium & PVC — Menuiserie Aluminium & PVC</title>
<meta id="metaDesc" name="description" content="Fabrication et installation de fenêtres, portes, cuisines et cabines de douche en aluminium et PVC.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Aluminium & PVC Workshop">
<meta property="og:description" content="Made to Fit. Built to Last.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><rect width=%22100%22 height=%22100%22 rx=%2220%22 fill=%22%23202124%22/><rect x=%2225%22 y=%2225%22 width=%2250%22 height=%2250%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%23A87945%22 stroke-width=%226%22/></svg>">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --charcoal:#202124;
  --graphite:#2F3133;
  --warm-white:#FAF9F6;
  --soft-gray:#E9EAEC;
  --medium-gray:#6B7075;
  --bronze:#A87945;
  --font-head:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Inter',sans-serif;
  --font-ar:'Cairo',sans-serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px;}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{
  background:var(--warm-white);
  color:var(--charcoal);
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
html[dir="rtl"] body{font-family:var(--font-ar);}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;}
.container{width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}

/* ---- Navbar ---- */
header{
  position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:100;
  background:rgba(250,249,246,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--soft-gray);
  transition:box-shadow .3s ease;
}
header.scrolled{box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(32,33,36,0.06);}
.nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px;}
.brand{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.brand span{color:var(--bronze);}
nav.links{display:flex;gap:32px;align-items:center;}
nav.links a{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--graphite);position:relative;}
nav.links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-6px;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--bronze);transition:width .25s ease;}
nav.links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;}
.lang-switch{display:flex;gap:6px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--medium-gray);}
.lang-switch button{padding:4px 7px;border-radius:4px;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.lang-switch button.active{color:var(--warm-white);background:var(--charcoal);}
.nav-cta{
  background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--warm-white);
  padding:10px 20px;border-radius:2px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;
  transition:background .25s ease;
}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--bronze);}
.burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;width:26px;}
.burger span{height:2px;background:var(--charcoal);width:100%;transition:.25s;}
.mobile-menu{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--warm-white);z-index:99;
  flex-direction:column;padding:100px 32px 40px;gap:28px;
}
.mobile-menu.open{display:flex;}
.mobile-menu a{font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:600;}
.mobile-menu .mob-cta{margin-top:12px;background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--warm-white);padding:14px;text-align:center;border-radius:2px;}
.mobile-close{position:absolute;top:24px;inset-inline-end:24px;font-size:1.8rem;}

@media(max-width:860px){
  nav.links{display:none;}
  .burger{display:flex;}
}

/* ---- Hero ---- */
.hero{
  position:relative;min-height:88vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;
  padding-bottom:64px;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(32,33,36,0.25) 0%, rgba(32,33,36,0.82) 100%),
    var(--hero-img, repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,#3a3d40 0 3px, #2F3133 3px 90px)) center/cover no-repeat;
}
.hero-bg .frame{
  position:absolute;inset:6%;border:1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.18);
}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:1;color:var(--warm-white);}
.hero-eyebrow{font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--soft-gray);margin-bottom:18px;font-weight:500;}
.hero h1{
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:600;
  font-size:clamp(2.1rem,5.4vw,3.6rem);line-height:1.08;max-width:820px;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.hero p{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--soft-gray);max-width:520px;margin-bottom:34px;}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 26px;
  font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;border-radius:2px;transition:all .25s ease;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--bronze);color:var(--warm-white);}
.btn-primary:hover{background:#93673a;}
.btn-outline{border:1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.5);color:var(--warm-white);}
.btn-outline:hover{background:rgba(250,249,246,0.1);}

/* ---- Section shared ---- */
section{padding:96px 0;}
.section-head{max-width:600px;margin-bottom:52px;}
.eyebrow{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--bronze);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:10px;}
h2{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.4rem);margin-bottom:14px;}
.section-head p{color:var(--medium-gray);font-size:1rem;max-width:520px;}

/* ---- Solutions ---- */
.solutions{background:var(--warm-white);}
.sol-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;background:var(--soft-gray);border:1px solid var(--soft-gray);}
.sol-card{background:var(--warm-white);padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.sol-img{
  aspect-ratio:4/3;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e4e2dc,#d3d0c8);
}
.sol-img svg,.sol-img img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.sol-body{padding:22px 22px 26px;}
.sol-body h3{font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;}
.sol-body p{font-size:.87rem;color:var(--medium-gray);margin-bottom:16px;}
.sol-link{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--charcoal);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bronze);padding-bottom:2px;}
@media(max-width:860px){.sol-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
@media(max-width:560px){.sol-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ---- Our Work / Gallery ---- */
.work{background:var(--graphite);color:var(--warm-white);}
.work .eyebrow{color:var(--bronze);}
.work .section-head p{color:var(--soft-gray);}
.filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:36px;}
.filter-btn{
  padding:8px 18px;border:1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.25);border-radius:20px;
  font-size:.82rem;color:var(--soft-gray);transition:all .2s ease;
}
.filter-btn.active,.filter-btn:hover{background:var(--warm-white);color:var(--charcoal);border-color:var(--warm-white);}
.gallery{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);grid-auto-rows:130px;gap:8px;
}
.g-item{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;background:#3a3d40;
}
.g-item.big{grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 2;}
.g-item.med{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2;}
.g-item.small{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 1;}
.g-item svg,.g-item img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .4s ease;}
.g-item:hover svg,.g-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);}
.g-item .tag{
  position:absolute;bottom:10px;inset-inline-start:12px;font-size:.72rem;
  color:var(--warm-white);background:rgba(32,33,36,0.55);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:12px;
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);grid-auto-rows:150px;}
  .g-item.big,.g-item.med{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2;}
  .g-item.small{grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1;}
}

/* Lightbox */
.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,20,21,0.95);z-index:200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.lightbox.open{display:flex;}
.lightbox-inner{position:relative;width:min(90vw,760px);}
.lightbox-inner svg,.lightbox-inner img{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:80vh;object-fit:contain;background:#2F3133;}
.lb-close,.lb-prev,.lb-next{position:absolute;color:var(--warm-white);font-size:1.6rem;padding:10px;}
.lb-close{top:-52px;inset-inline-end:0;}
.lb-prev{top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);inset-inline-start:-48px;}
.lb-next{top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);inset-inline-end:-48px;}
@media(max-width:600px){.lb-prev{inset-inline-start:4px;}.lb-next{inset-inline-end:4px;}}

/* ---- About ---- */
.about{background:var(--warm-white);}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:start;}
.about p.lead{color:var(--medium-gray);font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px;}
.points{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin-top:12px;}
.point h4{font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;}
.point p{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--medium-gray);}
.point::before{content:"";display:block;width:26px;height:2px;background:var(--bronze);margin-bottom:12px;}
@media(max-width:820px){.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;}}

/* ---- Contact ---- */
.contact{background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--warm-white);text-align:center;}
.contact h2{max-width:700px;margin:0 auto 14px;}
.contact p{color:var(--soft-gray);max-width:480px;margin:0 auto 44px;}
.contact-grid{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.c-card{
  background:var(--graphite);padding:28px 30px;border-radius:2px;width:220px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease;
}
.c-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);background:#37393c;}
.c-card svg{width:28px;height:28px;stroke:var(--bronze);}
.c-card .c-title{font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;}
.c-card .c-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--soft-gray);}

/* ---- Footer ---- */
footer{background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--soft-gray);border-top:1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.1);padding:48px 0 28px;}
.footer-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px;margin-bottom:32px;}
.footer-brand{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--warm-white);margin-bottom:6px;}
.footer-tag{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--medium-gray);}
.footer-links{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.85rem;}
.footer-social{display:flex;gap:20px;font-size:.85rem;}
.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.08);padding-top:20px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--medium-gray);text-align:center;}

[data-i18n]{transition:opacity .15s ease;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header id="siteHeader">
  <div class="container nav-inner">
    <div class="brand">Aluminium <span>&</span> PVC</div>
    <nav class="links">
      <a href="#hero" data-i18n="nav.home">Accueil</a>
      <a href="#solutions" data-i18n="nav.solutions">Solutions</a>
      <a href="#work" data-i18n="nav.work">Réalisations</a>
      <a href="#about" data-i18n="nav.about">À propos</a>
      <a href="#contact" data-i18n="nav.contact">Contact</a>
    </nav>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <div class="lang-switch">
        <button data-lang="fr" class="active">FR</button>
        <button data-lang="en">EN</button>
        <button data-lang="ar">AR</button>
      </div>
      <a href="#contact" class="nav-cta" data-i18n="nav.cta">Contact</a>
      <div class="burger" id="burgerBtn"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="mobile-menu" id="mobileMenu">
  <div class="mobile-close" id="mobileClose">&times;</div>
  <a href="#hero" data-i18n="nav.home">Accueil</a>
  <a href="#solutions" data-i18n="nav.solutions">Solutions</a>
  <a href="#work" data-i18n="nav.work">Réalisations</a>
  <a href="#about" data-i18n="nav.about">À propos</a>
  <a href="#contact" data-i18n="nav.contact">Contact</a>
  <a href="#contact" class="mob-cta" data-i18n="nav.cta">Contact</a>
</div>

<section class="hero" id="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg"><div class="frame"></div></div>
  <div class="container hero-content">
    <div class="hero-eyebrow" data-i18n="hero.eyebrow">Fenêtres — Portes — Cuisines — Cabines de douche</div>
    <h1 data-i18n="hero.title">Solutions en Aluminium & PVC conçues pour votre espace</h1>
    <p data-i18n="hero.text">Nous fabriquons et installons des fenêtres, portes, cuisines et cabines de douche en aluminium et PVC, ainsi que des solutions sur mesure adaptées à votre espace.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a href="#work" class="btn btn-primary" data-i18n="hero.cta1">Voir nos réalisations</a>
      <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-outline" data-i18n="hero.cta2">Nous contacter</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="solutions" id="solutions">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n="sol.eyebrow">Nos Solutions</div>
      <h2 data-i18n="sol.title">Nos Solutions</h2>
      <p data-i18n="sol.text">Des solutions pratiques et sur mesure en aluminium et PVC pour maisons, appartements, commerces et intérieurs modernes.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sol-grid" id="solGrid"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="work" id="work">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n="work.eyebrow">Réalisations</div>
      <h2 data-i18n="work.title">Nos Réalisations</h2>
      <p data-i18n="work.text">Une sélection de réalisations réelles en aluminium et PVC, fabriquées par notre atelier.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="filters" id="filters"></div>
    <div class="gallery" id="gallery"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="about" id="about">
  <div class="container about-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n="about.eyebrow">À propos</div>
      <h2 data-i18n="about.title">À propos de l'atelier</h2>
      <p class="lead" data-i18n="about.text">Nous sommes spécialisés dans la fabrication et l'installation de solutions en aluminium et PVC, avec un souci particulier de la finition, d'un design pratique et d'un travail adapté à chaque espace.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="points" id="pointsGrid"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="contact" id="contact">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n="contact.eyebrow">Contact</div>
    <h2 data-i18n="contact.title">Construisons ensemble une solution pour votre espace</h2>
    <p data-i18n="contact.text">Besoin de fenêtres, portes, cuisines ou d'un travail sur mesure en aluminium ou PVC ? Contactez-nous et dites-nous ce dont vous avez besoin.</p>
    <div class="contact-grid">
      <a href="https://wa.me/213792106924" target="_blank" class="c-card">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M20 3.9A10 10 0 0 0 3.5 16.8L2 22l5.3-1.4A10 10 0 1 0 20 3.9Z"/><path d="M8.5 8.4c.2-.5.5-.5.8-.5h.6c.2 0 .5 0 .7.5.3.6.9 2 1 2.1a.6.6 0 0 1 0 .6c-.2.3-.3.4-.5.7-.2.2-.4.4-.2.8.3.5 1 1.4 2.1 2.2 1.4 1 1.9 1.1 2.2.9.3-.1.7-.6.9-.9.2-.3.4-.2.7-.1.3.1 2 .9 2.3 1.1.3.1.5.2.6.4.1.2.1 1-.3 1.8-.4.8-1.9 1.6-2.6 1.6-.7 0-1.6-.1-4.6-1.8-3.6-2.1-5.6-6-5.7-6.3-.1-.3-.9-1.4-.9-2.6 0-1.2.6-1.8.8-2Z"/></svg>
        <div class="c-title" data-i18n="contact.wa_title">WhatsApp</div>
        <div class="c-sub" data-i18n="contact.wa_sub">Envoyez-nous un message</div>
      </a>
      <a href="tel:+213792106924" class="c-card">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M22 16.9v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.2 2 19.8 19.8 0 0 1-8.6-3.1 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6A19.8 19.8 0 0 1 2.1 4.2 2 2 0 0 1 4.1 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.7c.1.9.3 1.8.6 2.7a2 2 0 0 1-.5 2.1L8 9.7a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.2-1.2a2 2 0 0 1 2.1-.5c.9.3 1.8.5 2.7.6a2 2 0 0 1 1.7 2Z"/></svg>
        <div class="c-title" data-i18n="contact.call_title">Téléphone</div>
        <div class="c-sub" data-i18n="contact.call_sub">Appelez-nous</div>
      </a>
      <a href="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61575091777923" target="_blank" class="c-card">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M18 2h-3a5 5 0 0 0-5 5v3H7v4h3v8h4v-8h3l1-4h-4V7a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3Z"/></svg>
        <div class="c-title" data-i18n="contact.fb_title">Facebook</div>
        <div class="c-sub" data-i18n="contact.fb_sub">Visitez notre page</div>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="footer-inner">
      <div>
        <div class="footer-brand">Aluminium & PVC</div>
        <div class="footer-tag" data-i18n="footer.tag">Made to Fit. Built to Last.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-links">
        <a href="#hero" data-i18n="nav.home">Accueil</a>
        <a href="#solutions" data-i18n="nav.solutions">Solutions</a>

        <a href="#about" data-i18n="nav.about">À propos</a>

      </div>

    <button class="lb-close" id="lbClose">&times;</button>

<script>
/* ---------- Placeholder art (replace with real workshop photos) ---------- */
function ph(seed, tone){
  const tones = {
    dark:['#2F3133','#3a3d40'], mid:['#c9c6bd','#b7b3a8'], warm:['#d9d3c4','#c6bfae'], glass:['#dce3e2','#c3ccca']
  };
  const [c1,c2] = tones[tone]||tones.mid;
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <rect width="400" height="300" fill="${c1}"/>
    <g stroke="${c2}" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.9">
      <rect x="40" y="30" width="320" height="240" fill="none"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="30" x2="200" y2="270"/>
      <line x1="40" y1="150" x2="360" y2="150"/>
    </g>
    <text x="200" y="290" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#A87945" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.85">${seed}</text>
  </svg>`;
}

const SOLUTIONS = [
  {key:'alu_win', tone:'glass', img:'alu_win_3'},
  {key:'pvc_win', tone:'mid', img:'pvc_win_1'},
  {key:'doors', tone:'dark', img:'alu_door_1'},
  {key:'kitchens', tone:'warm', img:'kitchen_1'},
  {key:'shower', tone:'glass', img:'shower_1'},
  {key:'custom', tone:'dark', img:'alu_slide'},
];
const GALLERY = [
  {key:'g1', cat:'aluminium', size:'big', img:'alu_slide'},
  {key:'g2', cat:'pvc', size:'med', img:'pvc_win_2'},
  {key:'g3', cat:'kitchens', size:'small', img:'kitchen_1'},
  {key:'g4', cat:'shower', size:'small', img:'shower_1'},
  {key:'g5', cat:'aluminium', size:'med', img:'alu_door_1'},

const IMAGES = {"alu_door_1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "alu_door_2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "alu_door_3": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "alu_slide": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "alu_win_1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "alu_win_2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "alu_win_3": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "kitchen_1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pvc_door_1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pvc_door_2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pvc_win_1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pvc_win_2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "shower_1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "shower_2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};

let currentLang = 'fr';

function mediaFor(imgKey, seed, tone, alt){
  if(imgKey && IMAGES[imgKey]) return `<img src="${IMAGES[imgKey]}" alt="${alt}" loading="lazy">`;
  return ph(seed, tone);
}

function renderSolutions(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('solGrid');
  const t = I18N[currentLang];
  grid.innerHTML = SOLUTIONS.map(s=>`
    <div class="sol-card">
      <div class="sol-img">${mediaFor(s.img, s.key, s.tone, t['sol.'+s.key+'.t'])}</div>
      <div class="sol-body">
        <h3>${t['sol.'+s.key+'.t']}</h3>
        <p>${t['sol.'+s.key+'.d']}</p>
        <span class="sol-link">${t['sol.view']}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}

let activeFilter = 'all';
function renderGallery(){
  const t = I18N[currentLang];
  const filters = document.getElementById('filters');
  const cats = ['all','aluminium','pvc','kitchens','shower'];
  filters.innerHTML = cats.map(c=>`<button class="filter-btn ${c===activeFilter?'active':''}" data-cat="${c}">${t['f.'+c]}</button>`).join('');
  filters.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>{activeFilter=b.dataset.cat; renderGallery();}));

  const gal = document.getElementById('gallery');
  const items = GALLERY.filter(g=>activeFilter==='all'||g.cat===activeFilter);
  gal.innerHTML = items.map((g,i)=>`
    <div class="g-item ${g.size}" data-idx="${i}">
      ${mediaFor(g.img, g.key, g.tone, t['f.'+g.cat])}
      <span class="tag">${t['f.'+g.cat]}</span>
    </div>`).join('');
  gal.querySelectorAll('.g-item').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click', ()=>openLightbox(items, parseInt(el.dataset.idx))));
  window.__currentGalleryItems = items;
}

function renderPoints(){
  const t = I18N[currentLang];
  document.getElementById('pointsGrid').innerHTML = ['p1','p2','p3','p4'].map(p=>`
    <div class="point"><h4>${t[p+'.t']}</h4><p>${t[p+'.d']}</p></div>`).join('');
}

function applyI18n(){
  const t = I18N[currentLang];
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el=>{
    const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
    if(t[key]) el.textContent = t[key];
  });
  renderSolutions(); renderGallery(); renderPoints();
}

function setLang(lang){
  currentLang = lang;
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  document.documentElement.dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  document.querySelectorAll('.lang-switch button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.lang===lang));
  applyI18n();
}
document.querySelectorAll('.lang-switch button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>setLang(b.dataset.lang)));

/* Lightbox */
let lbItems = [], lbIndex = 0;
function openLightbox(items, idx){
  lbItems = items; lbIndex = idx;
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');
  renderLightbox();
}
function renderLightbox(){
  const g = lbItems[lbIndex];
  const t = I18N[currentLang];
  document.getElementById('lbImgWrap').innerHTML = mediaFor(g.img, g.key, g.tone, t['f.'+g.cat]);
}
document.getElementById('lbClose').addEventListener('click', ()=>document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open'));
document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target.id==='lightbox') e.currentTarget.classList.remove('open'); });
document.getElementById('lbPrev').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ lbIndex = (lbIndex-1+lbItems.length)%lbItems.length; renderLightbox(); });
document.getElementById('lbNext').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ lbIndex = (lbIndex+1)%lbItems.length; renderLightbox(); });

/* Mobile menu */
const burger = document.getElementById('burgerBtn');
const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
burger.addEventListener('click', ()=>mobileMenu.classList.add('open'));
document.getElementById('mobileClose').addEventListener('click', ()=>mobileMenu.classList.remove('open'));
mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click', ()=>mobileMenu.classList.remove('open')));

/* Sticky header shadow */
window.addEventListener('scroll', ()=>{
  document.getElementById('siteHeader').classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8);
});

if(IMAGES.alu_slide){
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--hero-img', `url(${IMAGES.alu_slide})`);
}
applyI18n();
</script>
</body>
</html>
